title: Operations Trainee
responsibilities: Support daily field operations across an assigned territory
Conduct site inspections and log findings
Coordinate with crew leads on scheduling and logistics
Complete rotational training across operations functions
minimumRequirements: Bachelor's degree or equivalent field experience
Comfortable working outdoors in varied conditions
preferredRequirements: Prior athletics, military, or team-based field experience
physicalRequirements: Able to lift up to 40 lbs
Able to stand and walk for extended periods outdoors
careerPath: Operations Trainee -> Field Supervisor -> Operations Manager
